text.KJV NEH 12:35: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

A.name: Shemaiah
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:8)

B.name: Shemaiah
B.line: Leader of the people processing at the wall's dedication

why: The Hebrew lists Shemaiah among the dedication procession’s participants, matching B’s stated role. Nothing identifies him as A, the covenant-signing priest; the ancestral Shemaiah in verse 35 belongs to a separate genealogy.
